title: The Hunt for Red October
author: Tom Clancy
summary: At the height of the Cold War, the captain of a new Soviet missile submarine steers west with a plan of his own. The Americans race to work out whether he is defecting or about to start a war.
readIf: you like technical, tightly plotted military thrillers with plenty of detail on submarines.
skipIf: you want character-led stories, because the book often stops for a long look at the hardware.

pairings.reason: Another thriller that is gripping because it follows methods and procedure in forensic detail.
A much quieter and more human view of Cold War espionage, driven by people instead of machines.
